note: The city has no general business license; licenses are required for certain business types through the Office of Licenses.

items.title: File NYC Business Corporation Tax return
items.description: C and S corporations doing business in New York City file NYC-2 / NYC-4S (or NYC-3L for general corporations) and pay the tax.

items.title: File NYC Unincorporated Business Tax (UBT) return
items.description: Sole proprietors, partnerships and LLCs taxed as such that carry on a business in New York City file NYC-202 / NYC-204 (4% rate, with credits for some owners).

items.title: Provide NYC Earned Safe and Sick Time
items.authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
items.description: Employers must provide safe and sick leave, post the required notice and give employees written policy.
